kurz: Chocolate is cocoa mass, [[kakaobutter|cocoa butter]] and sugar. The cocoa butter decides shine and snap; water is its biggest enemy.
bild_im_kopf: Like a fine crystal lattice that both heat and water can throw off balance.
was_passiert: Cocoa butter melts just below body temperature, which is why chocolate melts in the mouth. A little water makes it seize; a lot of liquid makes a smooth [[ganache|ganache]].
faustregeln: When melting: either no water at all or enough, at least a quarter of the chocolate's weight (as a guide). A few drops make it seize.
Melt gently, over a water bath or in short microwave bursts.
